attributes.title: Hang
attributes.lede: Shuffleboard. The puck goes as far as you flick it, and no further.

lesson.concept: Release velocity is information that layout cannot provide
lesson.why: The gesture snapshot supplies where the puck was released and how fast it was moving. Game logic chooses a legal destination, then Choreo stages the travel and follow-up instead of delegating everything to free inertia.
lesson.experiment: Flick from a similar release point at two speeds. Compare the resulting travel, then try Rubber hang and Decisive release for the transition response.
lesson.pitfall: Enabling automatic drag momentum as well as scored travel gives two systems ownership of the released puck.
lesson.combine: Combine with Follow for a label or shadow that must stay attached during the throw.
